text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A after a gain, but should judge every holding by its future prospects—not by whether selling locks in a gain or loss.","I let the account fall for several periods without trading; I should review each position against a consistent plan rather than react to losses or avoid admitting a mistake.","Past price moves do not predict future moves, so I should diversify and make decisions based on risk and current information, not recent performance."]}
